title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White
description: Join Ash accompanied by his partner Pikachu, as he travels through many regions, meets new friends and faces new challenges on his quest to become a Pokémon Master.

S14-E25Emolga and the New Volt Switch!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x1
episodes_data.description: Ash and his mother take a vacation with Professor Oak to the Unova region. A dark cloud reveals a mysterious Pokemon which affects Pikachu.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x2
episodes_data.description: After being struck by lightning, Pikachu is having trouble using its Electric-type attacks...but a second strange thunderstorm heals the Pokémon just as quickly! Attributing the ordeal to the Legendary Pokémon Zekrom, Professors Oak and Juniper agree that further research is needed.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x3
episodes_data.description: Ash and Iris try to help the owners of a Hot Sand Resort who are being plagued by Sandile.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x4
episodes_data.description: Ash and Iris stop at a Battle Club for some training. Ash's battle is interrupted by Team Rocket and a mysterious Pokemon.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x5
episodes_data.description: Ash arrives at the Striaton Gym for his first battle. The three gym leaders offer Ash a choice for the battle. Ash requests a battle with all three leaders.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x6
episodes_data.description: Ash's battle concludes. Cilan, impressed with Ash's victory, decides to journey with Ash to become a better connoisseur. Part of Team Rocket's plan is revealed.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x7
episodes_data.description: Ash and company encounter a wild Snivy with some really powerful attacks. They suspect it left its previous trainer. Ash is determined to catch the Snivy.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x8
episodes_data.description: Ash and company encounter a pair of Darumakas who steals food. They soon find they're bringing it to their friend who is psychically supporting a bell. Team Rocket's plans continue.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x9
episodes_data.description: Iris has a training battle with Cilan, and her past is explored.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x10
episodes_data.description: Ash challenges Trip to a full Pokemon battle.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x11
episodes_data.description: Ash and company encounter a Dweeble who has his shell stolen from him by other Dweeble. They aide him reclaiming his home.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x12
episodes_data.description: Ash and company encounter a Dweeble who has his shell stolen from him by other Dweeble. They aide him reclaiming his home.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x13
episodes_data.description: Ash and company meet Bianca, Professor Juniper's helper. She gives Ash a badge case, which is promptly stolen by a Minccino. Now the group tries to catch the Pokemon

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x14
episodes_data.description: Arriving in Nacrene City, our Heroes discover the Gym has a most unusual location and situation!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x15
episodes_data.description: The day for Ash's Nacrene City Gym Battle challenge is here, and Lenora isn't about to go easy on our Hero!

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x16
episodes_data.description: After some special training, Ash challenges Lenora to re-match.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x17
episodes_data.description: Ash's Pokemon egg finally hatches revealing a Scraggy.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x18
episodes_data.description: Ash and company get lost in Pinwheel Forest and encounter a wild Swaddle and Burgh, the next gym leader Ash wants to challenge.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x19
episodes_data.description: The adventurers encounter a Pokemon Connisuser who insists that Ash replace all his Pokémon. They soon discover she has a past with Cilan. And a Pokemon battle ensues.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x20
episodes_data.description: A previously encountered Sandile wants to battle Ash's Pikachu. But their battle is interrupted by some wild Duckletts.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x21
episodes_data.description: The adventurers cross a foggy bridge and seemingly into the past where they meet a young girl and her Gotitelle.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x22
episodes_data.description: The adventurers arrive in Castilla City and find that it's overrun with Venipede.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x23
episodes_data.description: Ash battles Burgh for his third badge.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x24
episodes_data.description: The adventurers try to help Bianca capture an Emolga.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x25
episodes_data.description: Iris attempts a training battle with her newly-acquired Emolga. But Emolga has other ideas.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x26
episodes_data.description: While taking cover from the rain, the adventurers encounter Team Rocket and some seemingly helpful Litwick.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x27
episodes_data.description: The adventurers meet Emmy, a trainer who has yet to start her journey. Iris reveals her dream to be a Dragon Master.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x28
episodes_data.description: During a battle with another trainer, Oshawott loses his scalchop, causing Oshawott to run off to search for it mid-battle.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x29
episodes_data.description: The adventurers try to help a wild Cottonee who's having during its mating season.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x30
episodes_data.description: The adventurers spot a UFO and encounter Professor Icarus, an expert on the subject.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x31
episodes_data.description: Ash and Trip have a 3-on-3 battle.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x32
episodes_data.description: Having learned why Oshuwott is having difficulty with Aquajet, Ash helps Oshuwott through special training.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x33
episodes_data.description: Iris is challenged by Georgia - a Dragon Buster. Iris's past with Excadrill is revealed.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x34
episodes_data.description: Ash attempts to capture a Roggenrola, but the battle is interrupted as they investigate Roggenrola's home and find Team Rocket.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x35
episodes_data.description: The adventurers encounter an Audino wandering aimlessly through a patch of fog. They soon find out the local town has been losing their Audinos. They offer to help find the missing Pokemon

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x36
episodes_data.description: The adventurers meet up with Doctors Juniper and Fennel as they work to bring back an ancient Pokemon from a fossil.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x37
episodes_data.description: The adventurers enter a fishing competition unaware that the competition is being run by Team Rocket.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x38
episodes_data.description: The adventurers make a movie.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x39
episodes_data.description: Day one at the Nimbasa Battle Tournament, a time to meet up with old friends and rivals.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x40
episodes_data.description: Day two of the battle tournament.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x41
episodes_data.description: Round 2 of the competition continues.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x42
episodes_data.description: The final round of the tournament: Ash vs Iris.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x43
episodes_data.description: Axew is kidnapped by a wild Scrafty who demands the adventurers train him for a battle. The get some unexpected help from Meowth who has just been fired from Team Rocket.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x44
episodes_data.description: The adventurers encounter a Purrloin who claims it needs their help.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x45
episodes_data.description: The adventurers meet Beheeyem, a Pokemon that can make dreams come true. They soon become trapped in a dream world and must find a way to escape.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x46
episodes_data.description: The adventurers rescue a Cubchew that got separated from its pack. They soon get in the middle of a feud between two groups of Beartic.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x47
episodes_data.description: Team Rocket executes their plan. They manage to steal several Pokemon, and use their "Ghost Train" to make their escape.

episodes_data.title: Pokémon Season 14 Black & White 14x48
episodes_data.description: The adventurers try to find Team Rocket's Ghost Train, and all the stolen Pokemon. Meanwhile Pikachu and Axchew try to free themselves and the other Pokemon.
